name: A Star-Touched Morning
summary: Lyra sensed something special in you. Introduce yourself to Seraphine at the Adventurer's Guild.

offer: You're the new adventurer? The stars whispered of your arrival last night.
Go see Seraphine at the Guild hall south-east of the plaza. She'll get you started.
progress: Seraphine's Guild hall is south-east of the fountain.
complete: Lyra sent you? Then you must be worth watching. Welcome, adventurer!

name: Slime Trouble
summary: Leaf Slimes are swarming Sunny Meadow, east of the village. Defeat 5 of them.

offer: Every adventurer earns their first stripes on slimes.
Head through the east gate to Sunny Meadow and defeat 5 Leaf Slimes. Click a monster to attack it!
progress: The slimes are just past the east gate. Use your potions if you get hurt.
complete: Not bad at all! You've got the instincts of a real adventurer.

name: Iron and Jelly
summary: Garrick the blacksmith needs Leafy Jelly to temper his blades. Bring him 5.

offer: Garrick uses slime jelly as quench oil — don't ask me why.
Bring him 5 Leafy Jelly from the slimes. He'll make it worth your while.
progress: Five jellies. Sticky ones. I'll wait.
complete: Ha! Perfect consistency. Here — a buckler and a bandana. Wear them with pride.

name: Whispers Beyond the Meadow
summary: Lyra senses astral disturbance in the Whispering Forest beyond Sunny Meadow. Find Ranger Elwin there.

offer: The runes I scried tonight were... wrong. Twisted, like thorns.
Travel east through Sunny Meadow into the Whispering Forest. Ranger Elwin keeps watch there.
progress: The forest lies at the far north-east of Sunny Meadow.
complete: Lyra sent you? Good. I need every blade I can get.

name: The Goblin Threat
summary: Forest Goblins have overrun the north-west camp. Thin their numbers.

offer: The goblins used to be cowards. Then the Thornking crowned himself.
Their camp lies north-west of here. Defeat 6 of them.
progress: Goblins fight in packs. Pull them one at a time if you can.
complete: Fine work. But the root of the problem still stands...

name: Crown of Thorns
summary: Grukk the Thornking holds the clearing to the south-east. Defeat him and end his reign.

offer: Grukk drank from an Astral Fracture. It twisted him into something... more.
He waits in the Thorn Clearing to the south-east. Watch the ground — when it glows red, MOVE.
Be at least level 14 before you face him, and bring potions.
progress: Red markings on the ground mean an attack is coming. Step out of them!
complete: You... actually did it. The forest breathes easier already.

name: News for Willowbrook
summary: Return to Willowbrook and tell Lyra about the Thornking's defeat.

offer: Lyra will want to know what we found. Take her this news.
progress: Lyra waits by the fountain in Willowbrook.
complete: An Astral Rune fragment, growing inside a goblin's crown...
This is only the beginning. Chapter I complete — the road to Silvercrest awaits.

name: Trial of the Shield
summary: To become a Knight, prove your courage by defeating 4 Forest Goblins in the Whispering Forest.

offer: A Knight stands between the weak and the wild.
Defeat 4 Forest Goblins in the Whispering Forest and return to me.
progress: The goblins lurk in the Whispering Forest beyond the meadow.
complete: Kneel... and rise, Knight of Willowbrook! Take this sword.

name: Trial of the Hunt
summary: To become a Ranger, hunt 4 Buzz Wasps and bring back 5 Rabbit Horns.

offer: A Ranger reads the wind and never misses twice.
Hunt 4 Buzz Wasps in Sunny Meadow and bring me 5 Rabbit Horns.
progress: Wasps nest in the south-east of the meadow.
complete: Clean kills, sharp eyes. You are a Ranger now. This bow is yours.

name: Trial of the Arcane
summary: To become a Mage, attune to the Astral Obelisk in Sunny Meadow and bring Lyra 5 Mushling Caps.

offer: Magic is not learned — it is listened to.
Lyra will test you. Attune to the Astral Obelisk in the meadow and gather 5 Mushling Caps for her.
progress: The Obelisk stands in the north of Sunny Meadow.
complete: I can hear the runes answering you. Welcome, Mage. Take my old wand.

name: Marla's Mushroom Soup
summary: Marla needs 5 Mushling Caps for her famous soup.

offer: My soup's famous across three villages! But I'm out of mushling caps.
Bring me 5 from Sunny Meadow?
progress: Mushlings hide in the north-east of the meadow.
complete: Wonderful! Here, have some potions — and come back for a bowl.

name: Carrot Defense
summary: Farmer Hollis wants proof you've dealt with the carrot thieves: 6 Rabbit Horns.

offer: Those horned menaces! Bring me 6 horns and I'll give you my old cape.
complete: My carrots thank you. Here, take the cape.

name: Buzzkill
summary: Buzz Wasps are terrorizing the south-east fields. Defeat 6.

offer: Wasps in the south-east field. Aggressive little things — they'll come at you.
Take care of 6 and I'll make it worth it.
progress: Mind the stingers. Green potions cure their poison.

name: The Old Well
summary: Theo wants a flask of water from the old well in the south-west of the village.

objectives.label: Draw water from the old well

offer: The old well's water tastes of starlight, they say. My knees are too old for the bucket.
Would you draw some for me?
progress: The well is just west of my house.
complete: Ahh... just like when I was a boy. Thank you.

name: Spore Sample
summary: Lyra wants 4 Spore Dust from the Venom Spores in the Whispering Forest to study astral corruption.

offer: The Venom Spores in the forest glow with astral light. That isn't natural.
Bring me 4 samples of their dust.
progress: They spit poison from a distance. Close in quickly.
complete: Fascinating... the corruption is spreading through living things.

name: The Falcon Pendant
summary: Elwin lost a precious pendant near the spore grove in the center of the forest.

offer: My mother's pendant... I dropped it fleeing the spores.
Look for something glinting near the spore grove.
progress: It should be near the middle of the forest.
complete: You found it! Please, take my falcon charm in return.

name: Restless Bones
summary: Bone Soldiers stir in the north-east ruins of the Whispering Forest. Put 5 to rest.

offer: Travelers report skeletons walking in the forest ruins. Skeletons!
Holy and fire hurt them most. Destroy 5.
progress: The ruins are in the far north-east of the forest.
complete: You have my thanks — and the village's.

name: Daily: Pest Control
summary: Keep the meadow safe: defeat 10 Leaf Slimes. Resets daily.

offer: The slimes never stop coming. Thin them out for me today?
